items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Fred paid the expenses for the trip because he was the one that was doing the business such as it was.

ctx.x: The day after the concert which was the 10th of April at the Cinema Theatro Bernini(ntohing to do with the hotel Bernini-Bristol) we taken a bus for Naples where the show was to start. Lily had gone back to Switzerland and was to come back definitely to Rome in 20 days. It was the first time I ever waited that long for a girl to come back to me.

We checked into a hotel and Fred went to find his man in order to know what time we would rehearse the show, He came back a few hours later and told us that there was not going to be any show. That was the 11th of March, and we came back to Rome by bus on the 12th. I never knew exactly what happened. Fred paid the expenses for the trip because he was the one that was doing the business such as it was.

I had a room in a place called Pensione Beccari on the via del Tritone and to cut down on expenses, I shared a two roomed bedroom with a hungarian fellow named Pista. Pista was a refugee, and there were quite a number of them-men and women-staying in this pensione. But the day that Lily returned, I moved to another room in the same place. While at this place, I met a West Indian fellow named Stanley Carter. I had heard of him, but never seen him. Stanley played piano and sang. His act was on the style of Morris…
